req.title: Cookie name path segment escaping
req.statement: The system shall percent-decode the <name> and <value> path segments in /cookies/set/<name>/<value>.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that /cookies/set/<name>/<value> must percent-decode the name and value path segments. Flask/Werkzeug automatically percent-decodes path segments before passing them to the route handler, so the set_cookie handler receives already-decoded strings. Tests must verify: (1) normal ASCII name/value sets the cookie correctly (EP positive), (2) percent-encoded special characters in name/value are decoded and set correctly (EP positive with encoding), (3) a percent-encoded space (%20) in name and value is decoded to a literal space (BVA), (4) a double-encoded value is only decoded once (BVA boundary), (5) an empty name segment causes a 404/405 (NEG), and (6) the redirect target is exactly /cookies (STC). We drive the Flask test client in follow_redirects=False mode to inspect the redirect, and also with follow_redirects=True to inspect the final cookie payload. Assertions are exact-value to maximise mutation kill rate.

tests.name: test_set_cookie_plain_name_value_positive
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
expected: JSON body contains cookies dict with key 'mycookie' equal to 'myvalue'
trace: R-HTTPBIN-044: plain ASCII name/value must be set verbatim
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_set_cookie_plain_name_value_positive():
    r = client.get('/cookies/set/mycookie/myvalue', follow_redirects=True)
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data is not None
    assert 'cookies' in data
    assert data['cookies']['mycookie'] == 'myvalue'
    assert len(data['cookies']) >= 1

test_set_cookie_plain_name_value_positive()

tests.name: test_set_cookie_percent_encoded_value_decoded
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Werkzeug decodes %20 to space before passing to handler
expected: JSON body cookies dict has key 'token' with value 'hello world' (space, not %20)
trace: R-HTTPBIN-044: percent-encoded value segment must be decoded; %20 -> space
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_set_cookie_percent_encoded_value_decoded():
    r = client.get('/cookies/set/token/hello%20world', follow_redirects=True)
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data is not None
    assert 'cookies' in data
    assert 'token' in data['cookies']
    assert data['cookies']['token'] == 'hello world'
    assert data['cookies']['token'] != 'hello%20world'

test_set_cookie_percent_encoded_value_decoded()

tests.name: test_set_cookie_redirect_location_exact
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
trace: R-HTTPBIN-044: set_cookie redirects to view_cookies; location must be /cookies exactly
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_set_cookie_redirect_location_exact():
    r = client.get('/cookies/set/a/b', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    location = r.headers.get('Location', '')
    assert location == '/cookies' or location.endswith('/cookies')
    assert 'set' not in location
    assert r.status_code != 200
    assert r.status_code != 301

test_set_cookie_redirect_location_exact()

tests.name: test_set_cookie_percent_encoded_space_boundary
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Boundary: single space encoded as %20 in value
expected: cookies['k'] == 'a b' (exactly one space between a and b)
trace: R-HTTPBIN-044: BVA on percent-decode boundary; single %20 must become exactly one space
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_set_cookie_percent_encoded_space_boundary():
    r = client.get('/cookies/set/k/a%20b', follow_redirects=True)
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data is not None
    assert 'cookies' in data
    assert 'k' in data['cookies']
    val = data['cookies']['k']
    assert val == 'a b'
    assert val != 'a%20b'
    assert val.count(' ') == 1

test_set_cookie_percent_encoded_space_boundary()

tests.name: test_set_cookie_double_encoded_only_decoded_once
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: %2520 is a double-encoded %20; single decode yields 'hello%20world'
expected: cookies['dbl'] == 'hello%20world' (only one level of decoding applied)
trace: R-HTTPBIN-044: BVA boundary — double-encoded value decoded exactly once by Werkzeug path routing
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_set_cookie_double_encoded_only_decoded_once():
    r = client.get('/cookies/set/dbl/hello%2520world', follow_redirects=True)
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data is not None
    assert 'cookies' in data
    assert 'dbl' in data['cookies']
    val = data['cookies']['dbl']
    assert val == 'hello%20world'
    assert val != 'hello world'

test_set_cookie_double_encoded_only_decoded_once()

tests.name: test_set_cookie_missing_value_segment_negative
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
expected: HTTP 404 (route not matched) — the route requires both <name> and <value> segments
trace: R-HTTPBIN-044: NEG — omitting the value path segment must not succeed; route requires two segments
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_set_cookie_missing_value_segment_negative():
    r = client.get('/cookies/set/onlyname', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 404
    assert r.status_code != 200
    assert r.status_code != 302

test_set_cookie_missing_value_segment_negative()

tests.name: test_set_cookie_special_chars_percent_encoded_name_and_value
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
trace: R-HTTPBIN-044: DT — both name and value contain percent-encoded special chars; both must be decoded
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_set_cookie_special_chars_percent_encoded_name_and_value():
    r = client.get('/cookies/set/my%2Dkey/val%3D1', follow_redirects=True)
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data is not None
    assert 'cookies' in data
    assert 'my-key' in data['cookies']
    assert data['cookies']['my-key'] == 'val=1'
    assert 'my%2Dkey' not in data['cookies']
